abstract:
PURPOSE: Optimal care for patients with metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) requires coordination across multiple providers, creating substantial time toxicity-the time patients spend engaged with the health care system. This study quantified total time toxicity and identified predictors of prolonged time toxicity in patients with metastatic PDAC.
METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed patients with metastatic PDAC treated at a high-volume center from 2018 to 2022, excluding those who did not receive cancer-directed therapy or received care at multiple facilities. Time toxicity was defined as the proportion of overall survival (OS) spent in cancer-related health care encounters, with hospice time excluded. Beta regression identified predictors of time toxicity, incorporating OS as a scaling factor. Secondary outcomes included systemic therapy in the last 30 days of life, hospice transition after hospitalization, and inpatient death.
RESULTS: Among 177 patients (median age 66 years; 57.1% male; 81.9% White), the majority received chemotherapy (n = 175) and palliative care consultation (n = 107). Median total time toxicity was 20% (IQR, 15%-28%), including 7% inpatient (IQR, 3%-16%) and 10% ambulatory (IQR, 8%-13%). Overall, 39% (n = 69) received systemic therapy in the last 30 days of life, 42.4% (n = 75) transitioned to hospice after hospitalization, and 14.8% (n = 21) died inpatient. On multivariable analysis, older age, rural/urban residence, and chemotherapy regimen predicted time toxicity (all P < .05). Each additional year of age was associated with a reduced time toxicity of 0.29%; urban residence was associated with a 3.3% increase in time toxicity compared with rural; and receiving multiple chemotherapy regimens was associated with 8.65% decrease compared with 5-fluorouracil-based regimens only.
CONCLUSION: Patients with metastatic PDAC spend roughly 1 in 5 days of survival engaged in health care interactions. Demographic, socioeconomic, and treatment-related factors all influence time toxicity.
key_points_ko: 전이성 췌장암 환자는 전체 생존기간의 중앙값 20%(약 5일 중 1일)를 의료 기관 이용에 소비했습니다.
전체 환자의 39%(69명)가 임종 전 30일 이내에 전신 항암 치료를 받았으며, 42.4%(75명)는 입원 치료 후 호스피스로 전원되었습니다.
도시 거주자는 시골 거주자에 비해 시간 독성이 3.3% 증가했고, 연령이 1세 증가할 때마다 시간 독성은 0.29% 감소했습니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 2018년부터 2022년까지 상급 병원에서 치료받은 전이성 췌관선암(PDAC) 환자 177명을 대상으로 의료 시스템 이용에 소요되는 시간 독성(time toxicity)을 분석했습니다. 연구 결과 전이성 췌장암 환자들은 전체 생존기간(OS)의 중앙값 20%를 병원 방문 및 입원 등 의료 관련 활동에 소비했습니다. 전체 환자의 39%는 임종 전 30일 이내에도 전신 항암 치료를 받았으며, 14.8%는 입원 중 사망했습니다. 고령일수록 시간 독성이 감소한 반면, 도시 거주 환자는 시골 거주 환자에 비해 시간 독성이 더 높았습니다.
title: Time Toxicity and End-of-Life Treatment of Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer
title_ko: 전이성 췌장암 환자의 시간 독성과 임종기 치료 실태
